item.title: Ballinasloe needs a family resource centre, Oireachtas committee told
item.description: A local TD has called for Ballinasloe to be added to the national network of family resource centres. Claire Kerrane was speaking at the Oireachtas committee on children and equality. The area, which serves a large rural hinterland, lacks a dedicated family resource centre despite clear demand from families, community groups, and service providers. item.title: Cocaine seized from house in Longford town
item.description: Investigations are continuing into a drugs seizure in Longford town. Gardaí from the Longford Divisional Drugs Unit carried the search of a house in the Richmond Street area of the town last Friday. During the course of the search, a quantity of cocaine was seized. Advertisement No arrests have been made.

item.title: Houses in west Roscommon are cheapest in Ireland
item.description: House prices in the Shannonside region have remained steady. That's according to the latest report from the Central Statistics Office. The Castlerea F45 eircode had the lowest median price in the country at €150,000, with a house in the Boyle F52 postcode €175,000. Advertisement Roscommon's F42 saw a median price of €260,000 in November, while properties in Longford's N39 were at €205,000. The Athlone N37 eircode was the most expensive locally at €315,000. item.title: It could be 2027 before Storm Éowyn clean-up is finished
item.description: The clean-up operation from Storm Éowyn locally could be set to continue into 2027. Among the worst areas was the Shannonside region with some homes, farms and businesses without power for over three weeks. Coillte have now stated that ongoing work will take longer than originally forecast. item.title: Roscommon's Farming Rathcroghan Project to close down
item.description: The Farming Rathcroghan Project in Co Roscommon is set to cease operations in March due to a lack of long-term funding. The award-winning initiative has supported 90 farmers in managing more than 260 archaeological sites over the past eight years. Despite repeated efforts, the project says state agencies responsible for heritage have provided little financial backing. item.title: CPR information event in Athlone on January 31
item.description: A CPR information event is set to take place in Athlone later this month. The Athlone Emergency Defibrillator Group are holding the event on Saturday the 31st of January in the Golden Island Shopping Centre. Athlone councillor John Dolan is the chairperson of the group. item.title: Local TD disappointed with non-commitment of Minister
item.description: A Fine Gael TD says he's disappointed the Children's Minister didn't announce a much-needed family resource centre for Longford town today. Norma Foley visited Attic House - the planned building for the centre. She said her department would decide in the coming weeks whether to fund it. item.title: Hopes public can attend new partnership meetings
item.description: The new chairperson of the Roscommon Local Community Safety Partnership says he'd like to see more meetings open to the public. Castlerea Councillor Paschal Fitzmaurice was elected as chairperson at their first meeting in the Abbey Hotel in Roscommon last night. The partnerships bring together a broader range of stake-holders than previous joint policing committees, and include local residents, HSE and Gardaí.
